text:
Morgan: Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A — leadership asked for a tangible playbook we can start this quarter to lock our serving advantage. Please keep it tactical.
Asha: Three short levers: 1) Migration friction (adapters, checklist, minimal-data-migration guides). 2) Economic clarity (per-route cost breakdowns, demo calculators). 3) Ops guarantees (SLA tiers + rollback hooks). I'll own the draft playbook.
Riley: Can we ship 2 low-effort, high-impact items this sprint so sales has something to show?
Noor: Engineering wins we can do fast: a tiny adapter CLI that maps common vendor streaming shapes to our API (2 dev-weeks), and a console widget showing per-route token estimates (1 sprint).
Hana: From product: build a "cost demo" template that Sales can fill with a customer's sample workload to show predictable unit economics. Template + one-pager in <48h.
Marco: Competitor note: hyperscalers push broad SLAs but not migration help. If we make migration painless and measurable we win stickiness.
Tess: Ops/legal: Dedicated deals need KMS + contract snippets up-front. I can make a short legal brief and a redlined clause bundle for Sales to attach.
Morgan: Good. Leadership also wants measurable signals to know if the playbook lands. Name 4 signals we can wire this quarter.
Asha: Four quick signals: 1) # Dedicated evals started from Sales playbook, 2) Trial->Paid conversion within 30 days, 3) Fraction of new customers using the adapter, 4) % change in tickets labeled "billing surprise."
Riley: For messaging experiments: two landing pages — A: "Predictable unit economics for production LLMs" B: "Reliable latency & rollout guarantees". Run homepage A/B for 2 weeks, track demo requests and Dedicated eval starts.
Noor: Dev note: adapter must avoid using proprietary SDK code. We'll provide mapping examples and open-source helper, not a "drop-in" copy. Legal ok?
Tess: Yes, as long as wording is neutral and we include a migration risk disclaimer. I'll sign off on the drafts.
Hana: I'll assemble the cost demo template and a guided checklist for Sales to run a 15-min cost workshop with prospects.
Marco: I'll create an internal competitor matrix column for "migration effort" and flag any vendor marketing that claims "drop-in". Weekly digest.
Asha: I'll publish the playbook draft by EOD Wednesday: sections = (Overview, 90-day epic, Quick wins, Play assets, Metrics).
Morgan: Action owners recap: Asha (playbook + 90-day epic), Noor (adapter + console widget), Hana (cost demo + sales checklist), Tess (legal brief + clauses), Marco (competitor migration digest), Riley (A/B experiment).
InfraBot: Note uploaded: all-hands playbook skeleton and artifact links -> https://confluence.redwood/ah/1777777777
Morgan: Thanks — reconvene in 10 days to review playbook progress and early signals. If anyone wants to join the migration-adapter working group ping me or Asha. :rocket:
